lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spots are arranged in a dense, non-linear cluster immediately posterior to the gill slits, transitioning into a regular grid of larger spots posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with large circular spots, forming primary anchor nodes in a rectangular coordinate-like arrangement along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a high-contrast transition between superior illumination and inferior shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) attached ventrally near the pectoral fin base; pectoral fin exhibits a uniform distribution of small, high-luminance circular spots.
